additions.reason: The Shekhinah is the Torah's central subject and is explicitly called a bechina of מלכות (and vice versa) throughout. The Rebbe says 'תתקן השכינה כדי לזוגה עם בעלה' and 'וכשהשכינה מתלבשת בלבושין נהירין.' The שכינה IS the מלכות, IS the תפלה, IS the אשת חיל — the package's central unity. While 'תקון השכינה' appears as a node, the bare concept 'שכינה' itself (as a named entity = מלכות) deserves its own direct bechina edge connecting it to מלכות and תפלה. This node is absent from the dataset for this Torah.
additions.source_quote: וְעִקָּר כַּוָּנָתְךָ יִהְיֶה, שֶׁתְּתַקֵּן הַשְּׁכִינָה כְּדֵי לְזַוְּגָהּ עִם בַּעְלָהּ

additions.reason: The Rebbe explicitly states 'גדלות היא ממלכות הרשעה, שרוצה להתגדל ולמלוך' — pride/arrogance IS from the wicked kingdom. This is a bechina statement: גדלות IS an expression of מלכות הרשעה. Furthermore, 'מחשבות של גדלות' (thoughts of arrogance) are what fall upon a person during prayer — they are the manifestation of the evil kingdom grabbing the Shekhinah. גדלות belongs in the evil mirror package (Package 2 below) but this package does not yet exist in the dataset because no evil-side bechina edges were recorded. This concept is present in the proof texts of the dataset (as narrative) but not as a bechina node itself.
additions.source_quote: גַּדְלוּת הִיא מִמַּלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה, שֶׁרוֹצָה לְהִתְגַּדֵּל וְלִמְלֹךְ

additions.reason: The wicked kingdom (מלכות הרשעה) is the evil mirror of Package 1's מלכות. The Rebbe says the Shekhinah 'is in exile within the wicked kingdom' and that the wicked kingdom grabs hold of her when she tries to emerge. מלכות הרשעה IS גדלות (pride) — they are bechinas of each other. This is the evil counterpart of the holy malkhut: same structure (a kingdom), opposite orientation. This evil-side bechina cluster (גדלות — מלכות הרשעה) is implicit in the text but not captured as bechina edges in the dataset. It should form its own evil package.

additions.reason: The Rebbe says: 'וכשהשכינה מתלבשת בלבושין נהירין: חוור סומק ירוק, בחינת אבות' — the luminous garments (white/red/green) that the Shekhinah wears when repaired ARE the bechina of the Patriarchs (Abraham/Isaac/Jacob = white/red/green = chesed/gevurah/tiferet). This is an explicit bechina statement: the Shekhinah's restored garments = the Patriarchs. These bechina nodes are entirely absent from the dataset for this Torah.

additions.reason: The Rebbe says the Shekhinah clothed in the patriarchal garments 'היא בחינת שבועה, בחינת שבעה' — she IS an aspect of oath (shevua) and seven (sheva). This double bechina (שכינה = שבועה = שבעה) is stated explicitly with the phrase 'בחינת.' The oath to the Patriarchs and the number seven are bechinas of the restored Shekhinah. These concepts are missing from the bechina dataset for this Torah.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset: שכינה (Shekhinah) — the Torah's central subject, implicitly equated to מלכות/תפלה throughout but lacking its own direct bechina node
גדלות (arrogance/pride) — 'גדלות היא ממלכות הרשעה' is an explicit bechina statement; this evil-mirror node is entirely absent
מלכות הרשעה (wicked kingdom) — the evil counterpart of Package 1's מלכות; appears only in eitza context in the dataset, never as a bechina endpoint
מחשבות של גדלות (thoughts of arrogance) — the experiential form of the evil kingdom's interference during prayer; could be a bechina of גדלות
לבושין נהירין / אבות (luminous garments = Patriarchs) — 'בחינת אבות' is explicit bechina language; entirely absent from the dataset
שבועה / שבעה (oath / seven) — 'והיא בחינת שבועה, בחינת שבעה' is a double bechina; entirely absent from the dataset
גלות / גלותא (exile) — the Shekhinah being in exile ('ואני בתוך הגולה') is described with bechina language but this concept is not a dataset node
קן (nest) — 'וכד אדם מתפלל בכח... ונעשית קן להקדוש-ברוך-הוא' — the Shekhinah becomes a nest; 'למקני' is interpreted as 'לשון קן.' Not in dataset.
analysis_notes.note_on_duplicates: The raw dataset contains 10 bechina-type entries for reference 1084, but after deduplication (identical node_id pairs with identical proof texts) there are 7 unique edges. Specifically: תפלה—מלכות appears twice (same proof); התחברות—תפלה appears twice (same proof); אני—תפלה appears twice (same proof). These duplicates do not affect the connected component analysis.
analysis_notes.note_on_evil_mirror: Torah 84 has a strong evil-mirror structure that is almost entirely absent from the bechina dataset. The good package (Package 1) centers on the holy Shekhinah = מלכות = תפלה = אני = אלקים. The evil mirror is the wicked kingdom = מלכות הרשעה = גדלות = מחשבות שגדלות. The Rebbe makes bechina statements about the evil side ('גדלות היא ממלכות הרשעה') but these were not captured in the dataset. The evil package should include: מלכות הרשעה, גדלות, מחשבות של גדלות, גאוה. All appear in proof texts but not as bechina node endpoints.
